package.name: msk_arm_nn
package.description: MSK-Arm: ROS Noetic two-link musculoskeletal arm driven by four Hill-type muscles (shoulder flexor/extensor, elbow flexor/extensor) in the reach / shelf / draw planar workspace tasks with obstacles; keyboard teleoperation of muscle activations, joint-encoder / end-effector / depth camera sensors, muscle-synergy reaching control, and pure-NumPy neural networks for depth perception, reaching control and end-to-end depth driving.
